risk_summary: The excerpt uses extensive standard forward-looking disclaimers and qualified language, while providing some useful quantified liquidity, debt, revenue-recognition, and preferred-stock redemption information. Management expresses moderate confidence that cash resources and projected operating cash flow will cover the next 12 months, but the evolving Marketplace model, dependence on contracts and customer adoption, and reliance on non-GAAP measures present material execution and liquidity risks.
